questions.stem: Which of the following is associated with chronic bronchitis?

options.label: C
options.text: The patients are called blue bloaters

questions.answerText: The patients are called blue bloaters
questions.solutionHtml:
The patients are called blue bloaters
  • Patients with chronic bronchitis are often referred to as blue bloaters due to the bluish discoloration(Cyanosis) of their skin from hypoxia and the associated peripheral edema.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 678

questions.stem: A 60-year-old man presents to the clinic with a persistent cough and sputum production for the past three months. He has a history of smoking for over 30 years and has been diagnosed with COPD. On physical examination, he has wheezing and crackles on auscultation. Which of the following is not true regarding the histopathology of the diagnosis?

options.label: A
options.text: Hyperemia, swelling, and edema of the mucous membranes

options.label: B
options.text: Chronic inflammation of airways predominantly with lymphocytes

options.label: C
options.text: Depleted mucus-secreting glands of trachea and bronchi

questions.answerText: Depleted mucus-secreting glands of trachea and bronchi
questions.solutionHtml:
Depleted mucus-secreting glands of trachea and bronchi
  • The given clinical scenario is suggestive of Chronic bronchitis.
  • Enlargement of the mucus-secreting glands in the trachea and bronchi is a characteristic feature, not depleted glands.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 679
